name: ai.clawfetch/mcp
registry_description: Web intelligence for AI agents: fetch, render, extract, research. x402 micropayments, no API keys.

tools.name: fetch_url
tools.description: Fetch a URL and return its content as clean markdown. Works for articles, docs, blogs, product pages â any static HTML. Cost: $0.001 per request.

maxChars.description: Maximum characters to return (default: no limit). Use to control response size.

tools.name: render_page
tools.description: Render a JavaScript-heavy page using a stealth browser and return clean markdown. Use for SPAs, React/Vue/Angular apps, pages behind JS rendering. Cost: $0.002 per request.

waitFor.description: CSS selector to wait for before extracting content (e.g., ".main-content", "#app")

tools.name: research_topic
tools.description: Research a topic using multiple sources. Returns a summary with cited sources. Great for market research, competitive analysis, fact-checking, and current events. Cost: $0.01 per request.

topic.description: The topic or question to research (e.g., "latest developments in AI agent frameworks")

sources.description: Number of sources to consult (default: 5, max: 10)

tools.name: check_domains
tools.description: Check if one or more domain names are available for registration. Cost: $0.002 per request.

domains.description: Array of domain names to check (e.g., ["example.com", "myapp.io"])

tools.name: suggest_domains
tools.description: Generate available domain name suggestions based on a keyword or concept. Cost: $0.002 per request.

query.description: Keyword or concept to generate domain suggestions for (e.g., "ai agent marketplace")

tlds.description: Preferred TLDs to check (e.g., [".com", ".io", ".ai"]). Default: common TLDs.

tools.name: extract_data
tools.description: Extract structured data from a URL using a specialized extractor. Supports 17+ site types including GitHub repos/profiles, npm packages, Twitter/X profiles, LinkedIn, YouTube, Product Hunt, Hacker News, Reddit, and more. Cost: $0.003 per request.

url.description: The URL to extract data from (e.g., "https://github.com/openai/openai-python", "https://www.npmjs.com/package/express")

type.description: Optional extractor override (e.g. "github", "coingecko"). Auto-detected from the URL when omitted.

tools.name: list_extractors
tools.description: List all available structured data extractors with their supported domains and fields. Use this to discover what sites ClawFetch can extract typed data from. Cost: $0.001.

tools.name: parse_document
tools.description: Parse an office document (docx, pptx, xlsx, pdf, odt, ods, odp, rtf, epub, csv, doc, ppt) into clean GitHub-Flavored Markdown. Provide a document URL or a local file path. Deterministic Rust converter â headings, tables, and lists preserved. No OCR: scanned/image-only PDFs are rejected. Cost: $0.002 per request.

url.description: URL of the document to download and parse (e.g. "https://example.com/report.docx")

path.description: Local file path of the document to parse (read and uploaded as bytes)

format.description: Optional explicit format override (e.g. "csv"). Auto-detected from bytes/extension when omitted.

tools.name: health_check
tools.description: Check the ClawFetch API health status. Free â no x402 payment required.

tools.name: wallet_info
tools.description: Get the wallet address being used for x402 payments. Useful for checking balance or funding the wallet.
